company.text: Discovery Life Sciences (DLS), headquartered in **Huntsville, Alabama** on the HudsonAlpha biotech campus, calls itself a leading global provider of **biospecimen products and specialty lab services**. It offers a commercial biospecimen network; multi-omic biomarker lab services (genomic, tissue biomarker, proteomic and cell-based); biomarker and companion-diagnostic programs for cancer, infectious and rare diseases; and, through **AllCells**, a recallable donor pool of human cells for cell and gene therapy. Past acquisitions include **Targos** (molecular pathology, Germany), **QualTek**, **ReachBio**, **East West Biopharma** and Corning's **Gentest** business. Spatial services include **10x Visium** (certified provider), **Xenium**, and **Lunaphore COMET** hyperplex immunofluorescence for CLIA-compliant assays. CEO **Greg Herrema** came from Thermo Fisher in Nov 2023.

industry.title: Service labs are the spatial on-ramp
industry.text: Many pharma teams buy spatial data as a service before buying instruments. Labs like DLS keep adding platforms (Visium, Xenium, COMET) to win those studies.

industry.title: From imaging to isolation
industry.text: Spatial imaging shows *where* the interesting cells are; the next demand is to **physically retrieve** them for deeper omics — the gap CosmoSort fills.

industry.title: Clinical-trial samples are scarce
industry.text: Biopsies are small and irreplaceable; tools that get more data per section are a strong sell to trial sponsors.

talking_points: Thanks for your patience on timing — here are a few slots that work in your afternoon. What would you like to see first: data, workflow, or a sample-to-result case?
Which spatial services are growing fastest for you today — **Visium, Xenium or COMET**? Where do clients ask for more than imaging?
Do clients ask you to **isolate specific cells or regions** after imaging (e.g., for sequencing or proteomics)? How do you do it today — laser capture?
How did the **Lunaphore COMET** service partnership work — instrument placement, co-marketing, CLIA validation?
Would a **pilot on DLS tissue** (one oncology use case) be a good first step to test CosmoSort as a service?
Could AllCells or the biospecimen side also use precise cell isolation (e.g., rare cell populations)?
